authorship: separate-assistant; synthetic; no human annotation or population representativeness claim
known_success: accepted AND correct_operation AND exact_value_digest AND exact_ordered_sources AND source_versions_valid
unsupported_failure: router_accepted, even if a later memory failure prevents final acceptance
raw_value_digest_canonicalization: JSON sort_keys=True separators=(',',':') ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False; UTF-8; None means no answer and has no digest
gate_scope: every predeclared seed/domain case, overall AND separately for each language
independent_language_units: 288 templates in 36 related families; no multiplication by seeds, entities or domains

intervals.wilson: 95% descriptive binomial intervals; independence assumption is not warranted for synthetic related templates
intervals.family_bootstrap: 95% percentile interval using 2000 whole-family resamples over template-averaged outcomes; descriptive, not a population-risk guarantee
